summary.interpretation: Correctness and invariance are separate; consistent wrong answers do not imply basic competence. Equivalent accepted moves are never graded wrong.
summary.statistical_scope: Correlated template/rank/role/permutation variants; no IID confidence interval or human-level rating

certificate.scope: each accepted move has universal hidden-world DDS optimality and one implementable public team continuation; ignores auction priors, conservative not exhaustive

transport.rule: inverse-transform the public observation, run canonical witness, transform its action back

limits: 8 tactical templates plus follow-suit and multiple-answer controls; not all bridge knowledge
2-4 trick endings embedded in legal complete games; synthetic development variants
No common optimum or no public continuation witness => ungraded
Template, role, seed and permutation variants are correlated, not independent test deals
Basic skill percentages are separate from random=0/DDS=100 match ratings
